sources.publisher: Reserve Bank of India (Office of the RBI Ombudsman)
sources.title: BE(A)WARE: A Booklet on Modus Operandi of Financial Frauds
sources.notes: Verified on 2026-10-28 by downloading the PDF and extracting its text. Section 3 (UPI collect request on online sales platforms), section 9 (QR code scam) and 'Actions to be taken after occurrence of a fraud' (helplines 155260 and 1930, cybercrime.gov.in) support the UPI and reporting claims.

sources.title: Press Release 2021-2022/1630: Consumer Awareness - Cyber Threats and Frauds
sources.notes: Verified on 2026-10-28 from the full HTML press release. Lists vishing, phishing, remote-access apps, misuse of UPI collect requests and fake bank numbers, and sets out the Safe Digital Banking Practices (never share PIN, UPI-PIN or OTP; receiving money needs no QR scan or PIN; block all debit modes after an unauthorised transaction).

sources.title: Financial Awareness Messages (FAME), 4th edition
sources.notes: RBI educational material, not a legal interpretation. Relevant messages include 1-3, 6-8, 10-11, 13-16 and 20.

sources.title: Saving and Risk Management, Financial Literacy Week 2025
sources.notes: RBI financial education page. It does not mandate a specific emergency-fund month count.
